label: Puducherry

b.name: CENTAC Information Brochure 2025-2026, NEET-PG Medical (M.D./M.S.) (the Google Drive link on the CENTAC site)

notes: CENTAC counsels government, management and Telugu-minority management seats together. Each round has its own rules, which apply to everyone once that round starts.

r1.title: Round 1
who: All NEET-PG 2025 qualified candidates who applied to CENTAC.
opts: You can resign before Round 2 registration without forfeiture. Only CENTAC can permit it; no college can.
A candidate admitted in Round 1 can resign from the seat before Round 2 registration without forfeiture.
The seat is cancelled; you can take part in Round 2. The brochure's Round 2 list names Round 1 non-joiners who have opted for free exit, without saying how to opt.
If a candidate fails to join the allotted / admitted seat (Fresh / Transfer) within the stipulated time, the seat will be automatically cancelled.
gaps: the round dates: the brochure leaves the schedule to the CENTAC website.
how to opt for free exit after not joining a Round 1 seat: the Round 2 list names it, and nothing explains it.

r2.title: Round 2
chips: Registration fee is the amount at risk
who: Those not allotted in Round 1, Round 1 joiners who want to slide, Round 1 non-joiners who took free exit, and applicants who skipped Round 1.
Registration fee to take part: Rs 25,000 (Rs 10,000 SC/ST) for government quota, Rs 2,00,000 for management quota.
opts: Your earlier seat is cancelled automatically; you can't keep it.

For a candidate who opts for sliding in Round 2 or Round 3 and is allotted a new seat, the earlier admitted seat will be automatically cancelled. Under no circumstances will he / she be permitted to retain the earlier admitted seat of the previous round.
A candidate who does not join the seat allotted in Round 2 (Transfer or Fresh) shall forfeit the amount applicable for Round 2 as specified in Clause 13.1.
Joined in Round 1 or 2 and resigning before Round 3 registration: you forfeit the Round 2 amount.
A candidate who has joined in Round 1 or Round 2 and resigns before Round 3 registration, shall forfeit the amount applicable for Round 2 as specified in Clause 13.1.

r3.title: Round 3
who: Round 1 or 2 joiners who want to slide, those who resigned with forfeiture before Round 3, non-joiners, and those not yet allotted.
Registration fee: Rs 1,00,000 (Rs 50,000 SC/ST) for government quota, Rs 2,00,000 for management quota.
Telugu-minority management seats convert to all-India general management seats, and vacant seats are de-reserved, in this round only.
opts: You can't resign, and you can't take part in the stray round. Resigning had to be done before Round 3 registration.
A candidate admitted in Round 1 or Round 2 can resign from the seat before Round 3 registration after which time, the candidate will not be allowed to vacate the admitted seat.
You forfeit the Round 3 amount, and can't take part in the stray round.
A candidate who does not join the seat allotted in Round 3 (Transfer or Fresh) shall forfeit the amount applicable for Round 3 as specified in Clause 13.1.

stray.title: Stray round
chips: Don't join: barred this year and next
who: Not allotted in Rounds 1 to 3, Round 1 or 2 non-joiners or resigners, and applicants who took no part in Rounds 1 to 3 and were not allotted any seat by MCC or another state's counselling.
Not eligible: anyone allotted in CENTAC Round 3, or who joined an MD/MS seat through CENTAC, MCC or any other state; you sign an undertaking saying so.
Registration fee: the full tuition fee for the course (Rs 1,00,000 for SC/ST in government quota).
opts: You forfeit the stray-round amount, are barred from counselling for the rest of this year and next year, and from the following year's NEET-PG exam.
The candidate will be debarred from participating in any further rounds of counselling in the same year as well as in the following year.
gaps: what the stray-round amount is called: the brochure calls it a registration fee, a tuition fee and a security deposit in different places.

after.title: Leaving the course
opts: The brochure states no bond or leaving penalty; it asks you to check with the college before filling choices.
Candidates are also advised to visit the college website or contact the college authorities directly for any query regarding additional fee / bond before filling choices.

reg: Application fee (once): government quota, for Puducherry residents, Rs 3,000 (SC/ST/PwD Rs 1,500); management quota Rs 5,000; if you apply to both, you pay the highest applicable fee. Round registration fees are the amounts below.
dep: No separate deposit: the Round 2, Round 3 and stray registration fees are the amounts at risk (Round 1 is free).
lose: Not joining a Round 2 or later seat; resigning a joined seat before Round 3 registration (the Round 2 amount; a Round 1 seat resigned before Round 2 registration costs nothing); and an admission cancelled for any reason, such as wrong information or missing documents.
back: Refunds start after the whole admission process and take about three months, to the account you paid from; the brochure doesn't say which amounts are refunded.
leave: No bond or leaving penalty stated; ask the college.
